title: After the Hanshin J.F.: Still Sprouting

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I lost the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies. I wasn't able to show off a grand victory to Trainer like I'd planned…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But the audience is impressed by how hard I tried, and even praise me! My performance seems to give Trainer some more confidence, too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Seeing Trainer smile makes me wonder if it was actually important that we met now, instead of later…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: If that's the case… I really want to bring home a victory for Trainer. Next up, I'm taking on the Oka Sho on the Tiara tour!
